unit: Rappaport Center for Law and Public Policy

labs.lab_name: Rappaport Center for Law and Public Policy
labs.location: Barat House, 885 Centre Street, Newton, MA 02459
labs.research_summary: A Boston College Law School center that builds leadership in state and local law and public policy through a paid summer fellowship, events and senior fellows.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 faculty director, 1 executive director, 1 administrative assistant
labs.join_notes: Summer fellowship: a paid 10-week policy internship in Massachusetts state or local government for law students at eight Massachusetts law schools, with a $10,000 stipend. Applications open December 2026 and close January 2027; applicants are pointed to their law school's public interest career services team.
labs.notes: Executive Director is Amanda Teo (amanda.teo@bc.edu); administrative assistant Alexis Albert (alexis.albert@bc.edu). The advisory board, senior fellows and visiting professors are not counted; the Senior Fellows page was not read. Phone is the number in the site footer.
